about: The steps of the validate job in .github/workflows/build.yml, for tools/ci_local.py.
A row with argv runs as: <python> -B <argv>. A row with builtin runs inside ci_local.py.
tools/test_ci_local.py fails when this table and build.yml disagree, and when a test, a check
or a --check tool under tools/ is neither a row here nor listed in not_in_ci with its reason.
ci_marker: text that build.yml must contain, for a step that CI runs in another form.

steps.what: no active item calls a global or field that nothing live defines
every trigger pattern fits one server-wrapped row
kb/mechanics clocks and scoreboard match the logs
the log parser and the clocks
kb/sim/rules.* match their sources (Lua files are inputs)
the census and the race table
the theorycraft CLI and the whole-fight engine
version.txt, mfile and _groups.yaml agree; CHANGELOG.md has that version's heading
this table against build.yml, and the runner's verdicts

not_in_ci.tools/check_colours.py: By decision (see its docstring): usage strings give false positives, so it runs by hand on the files a change names.
not_in_ci.tools/kb_log_import.py: Its --check compares each HTML export with its filed text. It reports on exports a person just added; it is not a gate on the tree.
